PLUGIN.NAME: Obsidian Connector
PLUGIN.DESCRIPTION: Link Super Productivity projects to existing pages in an Obsidian vault. Never creates a new page.

UI.LEDE: Pick an existing Super Productivity project and link it to an existing page in your Obsidian vault. The plugin never creates a new page.
UI.PLATFORM_DESKTOP: Desktop: load existing pages from the vault folder, then pick one. The plugin never creates a page.
UI.PLATFORM_MOBILE: Mobile / web: enter the vault-relative path of an existing Obsidian page. Disk browsing needs the desktop app. Opening still uses obsidian://.
UI.VAULT_NAME_HINT: The name shown in Obsidian. Used only to open the page with obsidian://
UI.VAULT_PATH_HINT: Absolute path to the vault. Desktop only — used to list existing pages.
UI.PROJECT_HINT: Only projects that already exist in Super Productivity are listed. This plugin never creates a project.
UI.PAGE_HINT: Choose a page that already exists in the vault. Nothing new is created.
UI.PAGE_SEARCH_FOR: Search existing pages… (matches for "{{title}}" are listed first)
UI.MANUAL_PAGE_HINT: Enter the vault-relative path of a page that already exists. On mobile, browsing the vault disk is unavailable — type the path of an existing note.
UI.EMPTY: No links yet. Choose an existing project, pick an existing Obsidian page, then click Link.
UI.CURRENT_UNLINKED: Not linked to an Obsidian page yet.
UI.PAGES_EMPTY: Set the vault path and click Load existing pages to list notes already in the vault.
UI.PAGES_NONE: No existing pages match this search.

MSG.NO_PROJECT_CONTEXT: Open a project first, then try again.
MSG.PROJECT_NOT_LINKED: This project is not linked to an Obsidian page yet.
MSG.OPENING_LINK_WINDOW: Open the Obsidian Connector panel to link "{{title}}" to an existing page.
MSG.URI_COPIED: Could not open Obsidian automatically. The URI was copied to the clipboard.
MSG.VAULT_PATH_REQUIRED: Enter the vault folder path on this computer, then load existing pages.
MSG.DESKTOP_ONLY: Listing existing Obsidian pages needs the Super Productivity desktop app, with file access allowed for this plugin.
MSG.PAGES_FAILED: Could not read existing vault pages.
MSG.LINKED: Project linked to the selected Obsidian page.
MSG.CHOOSE_PROJECT_FIRST: Choose an existing Super Productivity project first.
MSG.CHOOSE_PAGE: Select an existing Obsidian page (or enter its vault-relative path).
MSG.PAGE_MUST_EXIST: Pick a page from the list of existing vault notes. The plugin cannot create a new Obsidian page.
MSG.INVALID_PATH: Choose an existing page inside the vault (no absolute paths or ..).
MSG.CONFIRM_UNLINK: Remove the Obsidian page link for "{{title}}"? Nothing in the vault is deleted.
